explication: Kaneo is a project-management product: people organize team workspaces and projects, manage tasks and their context, and collaborate through views, notifications, and integrations. The graph centers on the documented user-to-result workflow and the API’s persistence layer, while retaining major documented capabilities whose implementation was not sampled. Edges reflect README statements or visible imports/calls; unsampled feature links are omitted rather than inferred.
